name: spinner
title: Spinner
description: An SVG spinner in currentColor, sized like an icon (sm, md, lg). Decorative by default; with a label it becomes a role=status region. Pulses instead of spinning under reduced motion.
docs: Decorative by default (`aria-hidden`): put it next to text that already says what is loading, or inside a Button, which shows it while pending. Pass `label` (in the page's language) when the spinner is the only sign of loading: it becomes `role="status"` with a screen-reader-only label.
